label: Preface tension blocked under ERROR_DEPENDENCE_1 and restored by local error
paraphrase: In every shared-plus-local profile: if every local condition is almost sure (ERROR_DEPENDENCE_1), then for every threshold t>1/2 and every n, the threshold policy (PRO_TANTO_SUPPORT_THRESHOLD_FULL_BELIEF_1) never accepts both an assertion and the event that at least one assertion is false. If the local condition has probability below one, then for every threshold t<1 there is N such that for all n≥N the at-least-one-false event is accepted, while each assertion is accepted exactly when t≤κ(G)·ν(C), independently of n. Dependence on a shared condition does not by itself remove the Makinson tension; the count of independent local error opportunities drives it. Threshold acceptance is the existing analyst policy, not epistemic warrant.
